title: Night Cream for Normal Skin: How to Choose and Use One
ex: Normal skin needs a light-to-medium night cream and only a pea-sized amount. Here is what to look for, how to adjust by season and common mistakes.
rt: Night Cream for Normal Skin: How to Choose | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for normal skin: what texture and ingredients to look for, how to adjust through Indian seasons, a simple night routine and mistakes to avoid.
quick: Normal skin does best with a light-to-medium night cream that keeps it comfortable without feeling greasy. A pea-sized amount is enough. Add actives only if you want a brighter or more even-looking tone, introduce one at a time, and wear sunscreen every morning.
facts: A pea-sized amount covers the face
Use a thinner layer in summer and monsoon
Add one active at a time
Give a cream 8–12 weeks before judging a more even look
